integrity: Reversible two-layer graph wave defined on all labelled states. Both companion algebra models and the direct 12-cycle boundary test were recomputed from included standalone Python code; graph-family universality is established by an explicit distance-matrix proof, not by numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to realized finite equal-order generalized hexagons and characteristic-two fields; matrix-kernel inputs can depend on the geometry; independent external mathematical audit and exhaustive historical-priority certification not performed.
title: Parity-separated reversible-wave clocks on finite generalized hexagons
